name: LGPD — for-profit company in Brazil
description: For a company running this website for profit in Brazil: IPs hashed in the records, and the Marco Civil access log on, which answers court orders.

ip-mode.reference: The access log answers the court orders, so the records stay minimal (LGPD art. 6 III).

access-log.reference: Marco Civil art. 15 requires it of a for-profit company, and a hash cannot answer a court order for the IP (art. 10).

access-log-retention-days.reference: At least 6 months (Marco Civil art. 15), deleted as soon as the term ends (Decreto 8.771/2016 art. 13 §2): 184 days is the longest 6-month span.

ip-retention-days.reference: CNIL rec. 2021-122: security logs 6 months to 1 year. A hashed IP is still pseudonymous personal data (GDPR art. 4(5); CJEU C-413/23 P), so it has a limit like any other.

contact-retention-days.reference: No law sets a number of days: keep a request while you answer it (LGPD arts. 15–16; GDPR art. 5(1)(e)); the CNIL keeps prospects' data at most 3 years after the last contact.

view-retention-days.reference: Audience statistics: the CNIL keeps them at most 25 months; 90 days serves the statistics with the least data (LGPD art. 6 III; GDPR art. 5(1)(c)).

summary-retention-days.reference: As contact requests: only while needed (LGPD arts. 15–16; GDPR art. 5(1)(e)).

backup-retention-days.reference: Data in a snapshot lives up to its retention + 90 days: 184 + 90 stays under one year.

notice-draft.reference: The privacy notice draft in pt-BR for Brazil.

checklist.text: Publish a privacy notice on the website (start from the draft on the Privacy page).
Name an encarregado / DPO and publish their identity and contact.
checklist.reference: LGPD art. 41; Res. CD/ANPD 18/2024 (only small-scale agents are spared, Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022)

checklist.text: Keep records of processing (start from What this server keeps).
Document a legitimate interest balancing test for the analytics and the IP hashes.
checklist.reference: LGPD art. 10; ANPD legitimate interest guide (2024)

checklist.text: Write an impact report for the agent, a new technology.
Offer a channel for data subjects' requests and answer in time.
Keep an incident response plan and a register of every incident.
checklist.reference: ANPD and data subjects within 3 business days; register kept 5 years (Res. CD/ANPD 15/2024)

checklist.text: Disclose access logs only on a court order, and keep preservation requests confidential.
Check the form and the chat for sensitive data and minors.
checklist.reference: LGPD arts. 11, 14; ECA Digital (Lei 15.211/2025) when minors are likely users

checklist.text: Sign processing terms with the model provider — no training on the conversations — and check the transfer.
checklist.reference: LGPD art. 33 (the EU is adequate, Res. CD/ANPD 32/2026; elsewhere Res. CD/ANPD 19/2024)

checklist.text: Tell visitors in the chat UI that they are talking to an AI.
